# List of acts of the 1st session of the 2nd Parliament of the United Kingdom

This is a complete list of acts of the 1st session of the 2nd Parliament of the United Kingdom which had regnal year  43 Geo. 3. This session met from 16 November 1802 until 12 August 1803.
